title: J.C. Tretter, back with the NFLPA as its top exec, says he'll use experience as a player to guide union over thorny issues with NFL

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: J.C. Tretter, back with the NFLPA as its top exec, says he'll use experience as a player to guide union over thorny issues with NFL
sources.description: That will influence when and whether the NFL expands to an 18-game regular season in the coming years; how the NFL navigates debate around grass and turf surfaces; and how the union advocates for players.
